summary: Comprehensive testing of Geofence Settings feature completed. Backend APIs 100% functional (12/12 tests passed). Frontend UI fully working with Office Locations CRUD, Geofence Categories display/edit, and Department Geofence assignments. Role-based access control verified - admin/hr can see Geofence menu, employees cannot.

minor.issue: Default geofence categories not auto-seeded when first category is added - requires manual seeding of campus/field/remote categories. Fixed by seeding them via PUT endpoint.
minor.fix_applied: Seeded all 4 default categories (office, campus, field, remote) via API

issues: Radius column shows '500 m' for campus category when it should show '1.0 km' - was showing radius of 'office' fallback before categories were seeded. Now fixed.

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/office-locations - creates new office with coordinates
Backend: Attendance check-in without location - works
Backend: Attendance check-in with valid location - works
Backend: Attendance check-in outside geofence - rejected properly
Frontend: Navigation to Geofence Settings via sidebar
Frontend: Add Office Location dialog - form fills and submits correctly
Frontend: Delete Office Location - confirmation dialog and deletion works
Frontend: Edit Geofence Category dialog - opens with correct values
Frontend: Assign Department Geofence dialog - opens with department dropdown
Frontend: Role-based access - employees cannot see Geofence menu
Frontend: All 4 geofence categories display with correct radius badges
critical_code_review_comments: Consider auto-seeding default geofence categories in database initialization rather than relying on API defaults - this prevents inconsistent state when one category is modified
seed_data_creation: Seeded 4 geofence categories (office, campus, field, remote) via PUT API endpoints
context_for_next_testing_agent: Geofence Settings feature fully implemented and tested. Office Locations CRUD, Geofence Categories edit, Department Assignments all working. Role-based access verified (admin/hr only). Pre-seeded data includes: Main HQ office, 4 geofence categories, Human Resources dept assigned to campus category.
